name: Haratsuma Nurse!!
source:
The main character lives alone in an apartment house. There are two beautiful housewives near his room and he is secretly in love with them. One day, he gets involved in an accident and is sent to hospital. There he finds two housewives!? Yes, they are nurses working there.... Like this, he enjoys his life in hospital being taken care of them....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090521102517/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012530]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
主角獨自住在一間公寓。附近住著兩位美麗的家庭主婦，他一直暗戀著她們。一天，主角遭遇事故，被送進醫院，竟在那裡再次見到這兩位主婦！？原來，她們都是在這家醫院工作的護理師……就這樣，在兩人的悉心照料下，他開始享受住院生活……
